steps.summary: Replayed stored procedure s_8f9ac5; observed h2=Request rate, h2_2=Error count, h2_3=Latency by endpoint.

Created a new dashboard, added a Stat visualization panel titled 'rpgr3-r2 Availability' using the TestData data source (default Random Walk scenario), set the dashboard name to 'rpgr3-r2 Bench Dashboard', and saved it. Verified: panel title is 'rpgr3-r2 Availability' (shown as h2 and in the Title field), data source is TestData (shown as 'A (TestData)' badge and TestData logo in the query editor), and the dashboard URL is http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efx2ayl1qlp1cc/rpgr3-r2-bench-dashboard after saving.

The replayed procedure created the 'rpgr3-r2 Notes' panel on the dashboard (that title appears in the left panel list button at @e3096). The panel has been given the title 'rpgr3-r2 Notes' but the visualization is still 'Time series' (default) rather than 'Text', and I was unable to switch it to Text (ran out of turns when trying to search for 'Text' in the visualization picker). The 'rpgr3-r2 Availability' Stat panel is also present. The dashboard title in the breadcrumb is 'rpgr3-r2 Bench Dashboard'. I could not verify the Text content or complete the save — the panel needs its visualization changed to 'Text' and then the text content needs to be entered in the Text mode editor before saving.

Completed both tasks on the 'rpgr3-r2 Bench Dashboard': (1) added the tag 'bench' in dashboard Settings > General — verified in the settings tags list (listitem 'bench' with a 'Remove "bench" tag' button); (2) the time range is set to 'Last 6 hours' — verified in the top bar time picker ('Time range selected: Last 6 hours'). Saved the dashboard with 'Update default time range' checked; the save was confirmed by the 'Dashboard saved' alert. After saving, the top bar still shows 'Last 6 hours' and the dashboard title in the breadcrumb is 'rpgr3-r2 Bench Dashboard'.

Set the dashboard auto-refresh interval to '1m' via the top bar refresh interval dropdown. Saved the dashboard; the save was confirmed by a 'Dashboard saved' alert. After saving, the top bar refresh interval button shows '1m' and the URL includes refresh=1m.

Verification completed on a fresh load of http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efx2ayl1qlp1cc/rpgr3-r2-bench-dashboard (UID efx2ayl1qlp1cc). (1) Breadcrumb title: 'rpgr3-r2 Bench Dashboard'. (2) Panels visible: two panels — 'Panel Title' and 'rpgr3-r2 Availability' (note: 'rpgr3-r2 Notes' appears only as a legend/series item inside the 'Panel Title' panel, not as a separate panel title). (3) Time range in top bar: 'Last 6 hours'. (4) Auto-refresh interval in top bar dropdown: '1m'. (5) Settings > General: tags list contains 'bench' (with a 'Remove "bench" tag' button); dashboard name is 'rpgr3-r2 Bench Dashboard'. (6) The 'rpgr3-r2 Availability' panel's query editor shows data source 'TestData' (query row 'A (TestData)' with the TestData logo); the editor was closed without saving. Nothing was changed.
